heading: Humanitarian care
lead: The Secretary may furnish hospital care or medical services as a humanitarian service in emergency cases, but the Secretary shall charge for such care and services at rates prescribed by the Secretary.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Prior section 1784 was renumbered section 3684 of this title.
